data.title: Heart Test Laboratories Agrees to Exchange Note for Shares
data.description:

On November 25, 2026, HeartSciences agreed with the holder of its January 13, 2026 promissory note to exchange, immediately after closing of the proposed transaction, a principal amount equal to a defined exchange amount for Class A common stock. Under the agreement, the number of exchange shares was to equal the exchange amount divided by a split-adjusted minimum price, with the exchange amount tied to 9.99% of post-closing Class A shares outstanding after specified issuances.

data.title: Icahn Enterprises Approves Revised Executive Employment Agreements
data.description:
An update from Icahn Enterprises ( (IEP) ) is now available.

On November 27, 2026, Icahn Enterprises GP’s board approved amended and restated employment agreements for Ted Papapostolou, the company’s president and chief executive officer, and Robert Flint, its chief financial officer and secretary. The agreements had an effective date of November 30, 2026, removed fixed employment terms and continued both executives’ employment on an at-will basis.

The agreements raised annualized base salaries to $6.5 million for Papapostolou from $3.5 million and to $2.25 million for Flint from $1.5 million. Neither executive would receive further Quarterly Awards or annual discretionary bonuses; prorated cash payments were specified for outstanding awards, which would be cancelled upon payment, while severance provisions and confidentiality, non-solicitation and non-competition covenants remained in place.

data.title: Mixed Martial Arts Group Receives NYSE American Listing Notice
data.description:
An announcement from Mixed Martial Arts Group ( (MMA) ) is now available.

Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited, doing business as MMA.INC, reported on November 27, 2026 that it had received a November 25 letter from NYSE Regulation stating it was below NYSE American’s continued-listing standard requiring at least US$2.0 million in stockholders’ equity after losses in two of its three most recent fiscal years. The notification related to equity reported in audited financial statements as of June 30, 2026.

The company’s ordinary shares continued to trade on NYSE American, and the company said the notification had no effect on its business, operations or SEC reporting obligations. It also reported a US$4 million ordinary-share equity raising at US$1.00 per share in August 2026 and estimated annualized cash operating-cost reductions of more than US$2.51 million, including more than US$800,000 implemented between July 1 and September 28, 2026.

data.title: Frontier Nuclear Receives Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Deficiency Notice
data.description:
The latest update is out from Frontier Nuclear and Minerals ( (FNUC) ).

Frontier Nuclear and Minerals is a nuclear fuel cycle company focused on building a U.S.-based nuclear fuel cycle platform through uranium exploration and development assets, and targeted investments in Australian enrichment-technology developer Ubaryon Pty. Ltd. and U.S. small modular light-water-reactor developer Kadmos Energy Services LLC.

On November 25, 2026, Frontier received Nasdaq’s written notification that its common shares had remained below the US$1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days from October 14 through November 24, putting the company out of compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The notification was not a delisting notice and had no immediate effect on trading; Frontier had until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance, while its business operations were unaffected.

data.title: Brookfield Renewable Partners Amends Proposed Simplification Ahead of December Vote
data.description:
Brookfield Renewable Partners ( ($TSE:BEP.UN) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. announced on November 27, 2026, amendments to its proposed corporate-structure simplification involving Brookfield Renewable Corporation and Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. The change followed more than 99% of votes cast supporting the proposal, while those votes represented about 62% of outstanding BEP units—insufficient for the originally contemplated two-thirds approval of a limited partnership agreement amendment.

Under the amended plan, BEP units would be exchanged one-for-one for BEP Inc. Class A shares, while BEP would become a BEP Inc. subsidiary; the transaction remains subject to Unitholder approval at a December 9, 2026 meeting requiring at least two-thirds of votes cast. If approved, BEP units would be delisted, BEP Inc. Class A shares would be listed subject to TSX and NYSE approval, and BEPC would be delisted and cease to be a reporting issuer.

data.title: Infobird Agrees to Sell Up to $10 Million in Convertible Notes
data.description:
Infobird Co ( (IFBD) ) has issued an announcement.

On November 26, 2026, Infobird Co., Ltd. entered into an agreement with a non-U.S. investor to sell convertible promissory notes with aggregate principal of up to $10 million in one or more closings through December 31, 2027. The notes carry 10% simple annual interest, mature 24 months after issuance and rank equally with the company’s other unsecured, unsubordinated obligations.

The investor may convert the notes into ordinary shares at 50% of the lowest closing price during the preceding five trading days, subject to a $0.50 floor and Nasdaq issuance limits absent shareholder approval. The agreement also provides for possible prepayment at 115%, default remedies and investor-demanded resale registration. The notes and shares were offered to a non-U.S. person under Regulation S and were not registered under U.S. securities laws.

data.title: Maison Solutions Receives Nasdaq Deficiency Notice After Board Resignation
data.description:
Maison Solutions Inc. Class A ( (MSS) ) has shared an announcement.

Maison Solutions announced on November 27, 2026, that Nasdaq had issued a notice of deficiency on November 24 after Bin Wang’s resignation from the Board and Audit Committee became effective on November 20, leaving the committee with two members rather than the three independent members required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2)(A).

The company had notified Nasdaq of the deficiency on November 19, and Nasdaq’s notice stated that the company would have a cure period ending at the earlier of its next annual shareholders’ meeting or November 20, 2027, or, if that meeting occurs before May 19, 2027, no later than May 19, 2027. Maison said it was searching for an additional independent director and expected to fill the vacancy within the cure period.

data.title: Malibu Boats Reaches SEC Settlement Over Disclosure Issues
data.description:

data.title: Sol-Gel Technologies Announces Nov. 30 Call on SGT-610 Top-Line Results
data.description:

Sol-Gel Technologies is a specialized dermatology company advancing therapies for rare and serious skin diseases. Its products and candidates include FDA-approved TWYNEO and EPSOLAY, plus investigational SGT-610 and SGT-210; SGT-610 is being developed to prevent new basal cell carcinoma lesions in adults with Gorlin syndrome.

On November 27, 2026, Sol-Gel announced it would host a conference call on November 30 to discuss top-line results from pivotal Phase 3 trial SGT-610-01. The trial was evaluating SGT-610, patidegib gel 2%, for preventing basal cell carcinoma lesions in adults with Gorlin syndrome.
